environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on ECS Fargate with the following infrastructure configuration: (1) The container's /var/app filesystem is mounted with a read-only overlay on /var/app/preview-cache using a tmpfs volume with 'nofollow' mount option (mount -t tmpfs -o nofollow,size=50M tmpfs /var/app/preview-cache), which causes the kernel to refuse to traverse symlinks in that directory when O_NOFOLLOW semantics are enforced by the static file provider. (2) The ALB has an associated AWS WAF WebACL with a custom response header injection rule that appends 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src \'self\'; script-src \'none\'; object-src \'none\'; base-uri \'self\'' to all responses with content-type text/html, configured via a WAF rule action override with custom response headers (not application-level middleware). (3) The ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary that denies s3:* and ssm:GetParameter, limiting lateral movement even if arbitrary file read is achieved.

config.filesystem: ext4 with tmpfs overlay on preview-cache, mount option nofollow
config.waf_rules: Custom rule: inject CSP header on text/html responses via action override custom_response_headers
